sections.title: Property Sheet (§30G) — PROP-N, her house
sections.md:
| Field | PROP-N |
|---|---|
| 1 Type and era | 1960s two-storey red-brick colonial-style house, tree-lined suburb of Atlanta, Georgia — rendered as a Pixar storybook house, lived-in and a little worn |
| 2 Shell | warm greige walls scuffed at hip height · plain white baseboards · colonial-profile white casings · white six-panel doors, round brass knobs · brass-and-frosted flush lights · **honey oak floors → worn beige carpet on the stairs and landing → cream vinyl tile in the kitchen** · floor vents · ivory rocker switches |
| 3 Floor map | front door → hall; the straight staircase rises along the **right-hand wall** to the landing, open on its left with white balusters and a dark oak rail; the **stair wall is the family-photo wall** (soft painted blurs, no readable faces); kitchen through the doorway at the far end, left; living room off the hall; bedroom off the landing |
| 4 Orientation | front (door sidelights) faces **west**; landing window **south**; kitchen sink window **south**; bedroom window east; living-room window front (west) |
| 5 Carried elements | the photo wall · the dark oak rail and newel · the beige stair runner continuing onto the landing · the console table with the key bowl · the coat tree with the navy raincoat and straw hat |
| 6 Exterior | red brick, black shutters, small white front porch with two rocking chairs, straight concrete path to the sidewalk, big oaks (P6-STREET); every window looks out at the oaks and the street |
| 7 Standing negatives | none yet (first plates) |
